description: This file defines the ServiceEventHandler class, which implements event handling logic for invoking services within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages service invocation modes (sync/async), prepares service context data from HTTP request attributes, performs validation, calls the dispatcher to execute services, and processes responses and errors.

classes.name: ServiceEventHandler
classes.description: Class implementing event handling for service invocation in OFBiz, supporting synchronous and asynchronous execution modes, including context preparation, validation, invocation, and response handling.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the event handler with the servlet context. Currently, it performs no specific setup.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Handles the event by invoking a service based on the event details and request context. It manages service mode determination, context data collection, validation, execution via dispatcher, and response processing, including error handling.
